name: Claude Customer Support Agent
description: Next.js customer-support chat powered by Claude with retrieval from Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases.
whatItDoes: It answers customer questions from a company knowledge base, shows its sources and reasoning, detects the user's mood and flags when a human agent should take over. A customisable starter for support teams.
howItWorks: A Next.js app calls Claude with context retrieved from a Bedrock Knowledge Base and renders structured output including debug details and redirection hints.

requirements.name: BAWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requirements.description: AWS key for Bedrock Knowledge Bases

requirements.name: BAWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
requirements.description: AWS secret for Bedrock Knowledge Bases
